description: Propose a booking. This does NOT book anything and does NOT reserve the time: it emails the person a confirmation link valid for thirty minutes, and only their click puts it in the calendar. The slot stays open to everybody else meanwhile, so tell them to expect that email and to act on it rather than assume the time is theirs.

email.description: Their email. The confirmation goes here, so it must be theirs and correct.

message.description: What they want to discuss, in their words where possible.

platform.description: What they are running, if known.

start.description: ISO 8601 start time, taken from check_availability rather than guessed.

name: request_consultation
